title: Long-play DestructoRay reset callback evidence

callback.retailBehavior: Calls the object's state method at vtable slot 0x60 with false, then tail-calls the base reset at 0x00097C00, which clears state bytes at offsets 0x34 and 0x37.

neighboringMatches: alpha UFO::WeaponDestructoRay::ProcessEvent aligns exactly in shape with retail 0x000A2680

limits: The callback explains skipped DestructoRay reset behavior; it does not by itself prove the reported firing cadence differed from xemu.
The currently running process predates this repair. A fresh run on the staged executable must show that 0x000A21A0 no longer falls through unresolved dispatch.
The reported G-man hats, invisible characters, tank, cutscene effects, broken transient models, freeze, and text faults remain separate observations until a shared state or call boundary is captured.
